problems: Model RAM hit returned and changed visible pin without checking cancellation after lookup.
A cancelled swap lookup became a cache miss and invoked native decode before final cancellation check.
fix: Production load delegates to a checked helper with the real generation-token predicate. Recheck resident result before pin change, swap result before decode fallback, retry before native decode, and memory refusal before evicting another model. Final pre-publication cancellation check retained.
metal: Actual Metal Apple M4 Max required via RRRAH_GPU_BACKEND=metal and RRRAH_GPU_OPTIONAL=0; STL, OBJ, PLY and OFF native managed geometry/readback and exact swap frame checks pass.
limitations: Deterministic generation-predicate controls cover cancellation boundaries, not physical-window navigation latency.
Metal integrations cover authored fixtures and existing common geometry/transport assertions, not every 3D producer/material/texture variant.
Publication remains a checked boundary, not an atomic transaction with external generation mutation.
No NVIDIA or physical HDR qualification in these tests.
